name: Dream Delirio's
description:
About This Game

Dream Delirio's is a fast-paced arena twin-stick shooter roguelike inspired by early-2010s cartoons, with a psychedelic twist. Blast your way through waves of children’s nightmares with a variety of guns and skill cards. Unlock upgrades, discover new weapons and abilities, build insane combos and synergies, and make the world’s bravest and delicious cereal!

Take on relentless waves of nightmarish creatures with special weapons and powers in Dream Delirio's. Mix and match different guns and upgradable ability cards to reach new heights of chaos—and dominate every enemy in sight.

In this arena twin-stick shooter with roguelike elements, you’ll fight through successive waves of enemies, each more terrifying than the last. Choose your favorite weapons and skill cards to create powerful synergies. Explore upgrade paths tied to a cast of quirky characters and archetypes, increasing stats like speed, damage, and more. Find the perfect build that makes you completely unstoppable.

Magnus—the face of the Dream Delirio's cereal brand—has an eternal mission: to protect children by helping them conquer their deepest fears and nightmares. Armed with a unique arsenal and abilities of his many friends, Magnus ventures into the dreamscapes of children’s minds. Defeat each nightmare to gather the ingredients needed to craft the world’s greatest, bravest cereal, making kids everywhere more courageous. Along the way, uncover his companions’ hidden pasts and tangled relationships.

  • KEEP MOVING:
    Jump in and out of runs quickly, survive 20 adrenaline-packed minutes, and see how far you can push the Delirium meter.

  • UNIQUE WEAPONS:
    From rapid-fire Machine Guns to a cheeky Slingshot and even a Jousting Lance, each weapon brings its own playstyle.

  • HARD MODE:
    Crank up the challenge to unlock new cards, weapons, characters, and secret lore ... if you dare.

  • +70 CARDS:
    Unique cards to collect and upgrade, position and combine them to discover devastating synergies.

  • CRUCIAL CARD POSITIONING:
    Position your cards strategically as they interact with one another; the order matters and can make any build cataclysmic!

Prepare for a psychedelic, fast-paced ride through the wildest corners of the subconscious. Grab your controller (or mouse and keyboard), pick your loadout, and prove you have the guts to face Dream Delirio's!
short_desc: Blast through waves of children’s nightmares with Magnus, a cereal mascot fighting to free the children from their fears. Weaponize your breakfast, build game-breaking card synergies and show these nightmares that crunch time is over.
